subject: BlueForge HQ visit coordination and NDA
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@blueforge.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to schedule on-site demo + NDA

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the product overview yesterday — the team at BlueForge is excited to see Redwood running on-prem and to align on latency/cost numbers for our use case. We'd like to visit your HQ for a short on-site demo and infrastructure walkthrough.

High-level ask: could we schedule a half-day visit the week of Apr 13–17? Key items: 1) a live demo with up to 6 people (product, infra, procurement), 2) a short ops Q&A with your infra team, and 3) signature or execution of an NDA before the visit.

Practical questions: do you provide visitor badges and parking passes? Any building access rules we should know about? We can sign a mutual NDA — if you have a template we can review.

Cc'ing Sara from procurement who will coordinate travel: sara.li@blueforge.ai

Thanks — look forward to making this concrete.

Cheers,
Oliver Grant
Head of Partnerships
BlueForge Analytics
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@blueforge.ai>, Sara Li <sara.li@blueforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-03T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule on-site demo + NDA

Oliver/Sara — thanks for the note and excited to host.

We can do a half day onsite at our SF HQ the week of Apr 13–17. Current openings on our side: Apr 14 (afternoon) or Apr 16 (morning). Please let me know which works best for you and the final headcount.

I've attached our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf). If you prefer DocuSign, we can send that link and get it returned before the visit. Our security team requires an executed NDA prior to any access to non-public infra or floor-level tours; a high-level demo in the conference room is fine without it but we generally prefer the NDA.

Regarding logistics: we can arrange visitor badges and two parking passes (first-come basis) — Marissa (cc) handles on-site ops and will confirm room bookings and parking. Building check-in requires a government ID.

Next steps I recommend: 1) confirm a date (14 or 16), 2) confirm headcount and attendee names, 3) sign NDA (attached) or confirm DocuSign. I'll draft a calendar invite once we have a date.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
cell: (415) 555-0132
From: Sara Li <sara.li@blueforge.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, Oliver Grant <oliver@blueforge.ai>
Date: 2026-04-04T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule on-site demo + NDA

Hi Dylan,

Thanks — appreciate the options. A couple of constraints from procurement/travel: our CD for the week of Apr 13 has a roadmap review on Apr 14 AM, so the Apr 14 afternoon slot would work better, but one of our infra leads can't travel until Apr 16. Would you be able to host us on Apr 14 afternoon for the core demo team (4 people) and then do a short follow-up ops sync with the infra lead remotely or — if feasible — on Apr 16 morning for the full group? We prefer Apr 14 afternoon as the primary on-site date and a short ops-only session on Apr 16 morning if you can accommodate.

We're fine with the attached NDA — I'll sign and return via DocuSign if you send the link. For visitor logistics: can you confirm parking location (street vs lot) and whether there is a loading dock for equipment? Nothing large, but the infra lead may bring a laptop rack case. Also, do you have a preferred Wi-Fi guest SSID or should we plan to tether?

Oliver and I will confirm the 4 attendees by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Sara Li
Senior Procurement Manager
BlueForge Analytics
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sara Li <sara.li@blueforge.ai>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-05T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule on-site demo + NDA

Hi Sara — great, glad Apr 14 afternoon works as the onsite window.

Logistics we can provide:
- Conference room: 3F/Westboard (seats 8) reserved Apr 14, 13:00–17:00. AV: HDMI, 2x USB-C adapters, conference phone.
- Follow-up ops slot: Apr 16 09:00–10:00 reserved as a virtual bridge (we can host either in-person if your infra lead can make it).
- Parking: we will email two guest parking permits for our attached visitor lot (map: visitor_parking_map.png). The lot is behind the building — enter on 7th Street; gate code provided on the day of visit.
- Loading: there is a small service entrance with a short ramp; load-in windows are on weekdays 08:00–10:00 and 16:30–18:00.
- Guest Wi-Fi: Redwood-Guest (voucher access). We will provide passcodes at check-in.

I've uploaded HQ_floorplan_3F.pdf for your incoming routing — the Westboard room is highlighted. To expedite check-in, please provide full legal names and driver's license numbers for the 4 attendees when you send the finalized list.

I'll also attach the DocuSign link and will send the official calendar invite once we have the final attendee list and signed NDA. Ava (cc) is on security approvals and will confirm once the signed NDA comes through — she can raise any exceptions if needed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Events & Onsite Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@blueforge.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ava_chen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-06T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule on-site demo + NDA

Dylan/Marissa/Ava — quick update and confirmation.

We will take Apr 14, 13:00–17:00 at your HQ for the demo. Attendees (in-person):
- Oliver Grant (head of partnerships)
- Sara Li (procurement)
- Tom Reed (infra lead)
- Priya Mehta (product)

Tom needs the Apr 16 09:00–10:00 ops-only session as remote dial-in for deeper infra questions; he can't travel until Apr 16 morning. We'll sign the NDA via the DocuSign link you provided today and return before Apr 13. Tom will likely bring a rolling laptop case only — no large equipment.

Driver's license numbers and legal names will be provided by EOD Apr 10. Thanks for the quick coordination — could you confirm the calendar invite includes the building gate code and Marissa's onsite cell? That will help our travel team.

Thanks,
Oliver
